_comment: Cross-language known-answer vectors for the SEC-2 key hierarchy.
The desktop (Rust) and the backend/web (TypeScript) must derive IDENTICAL keys, or a profile
sealed on one and restored by the other silently fails to open. Both languages assert against
this file, so a divergence in EITHER fails a test instead of surfacing as an unopenable backup.
Generated by packages/crypto; regenerate ONLY when the hierarchy is deliberately versioned, and
expect that to invalidate every existing sealed snapshot.
